title: HAUS Study Scholarship
summary: Study scholarship for U.S. students planning to study at Universität Heidelberg for bachelor’s or master’s programs.

degree_levels.notes: For undergraduate or master's program students.

subject_areas.notes: All disciplines allowed by individual university programs, but specific subjects are not restricted or detailed on the scholarship page itself.

nationality.notes: United States residency and U.S. higher education enrollment required.

residence.notes: Candidates must have United States residency and be enrolled at or graduated from an institution of higher education in the U.S.

mandatory.text: Undergraduate or master's program student with strong academic credentials enrolled at - or graduated from - an institution of higher education in the U.S.
Acceptance as student at Heidelberg University (proof can be submitted at a later time)
Successfully complete academic program at Heidelberg University
Register with Heidelberg Alumni International (HAI) and HAUS upon arrival and cooperate with HAI while in Heidelberg
Participate in Heidelberg HAUS chapter events
Serve as an ambassador for HAUS and Heidelberg University after completing studies in Heidelberg
Provide a report on your time at Heidelberg University, including good-quality photos
Adhere to all federal and local public health and safety regulations

preferences.text: Candidates with a strong academic background who can also fulfill the role of ambassador for HAUS

exceptions.text: Students currently enrolled at Heidelberg University are not eligible for the HAUS Scholarship.

funding.description: The scholarship award is $7,000 for master's program students or $4,500 for bachelor's program students for one semester with the possibility to extend for a second semester, pending availability of funds.
funding.duration: One semester with the possibility to extend for a second semester

application_rounds.notes: The HAUS Study Scholarship application for 2026/27 is now closed.

sources.title: HAUS Study Scholarship - Heidelberg University Association
sources.notes: Supports U.S. students physically studying at Heidelberg University in Germany.
